title: Neural networks are more modular than single neurons suggest
abstract: arXiv:2610.12842v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks routinely develop representations in which individual neurons contribute to multiple distinct functions, leading to the widespread view that such networks lack modular organization. We challenge this conclusion by introducing a formally nested hierarchy of modularity: unit-level, which requires distinct computations to occupy disjoint neurons; orthogonal, which asks whether a rotation reveals functionally independent subspaces; and linear, which asks whether a bounded linear map can separate task-relevant computations into independent subspaces. We develop a unified framework for learning decompositions at each level and evaluating them causally through selective ablation. Across vision models, language models and multi-task Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), we find that networks which lack unit-level modularity nonetheless often exhibit clear functional modularity at the subspace level. translated_title: 神经网络比单个神经元所暗示的更具模块化性
translated_abstract: 神经网络通常会发展出单个神经元同时参与多种不同功能的表示，这导致了一种普遍观点，即此类网络缺乏模块化组织。我们通过引入一个形式化的嵌套模块化层次结构来挑战这一结论：单元级模块化，要求不同的计算占据互不相交的神经元；正交级模块化，探讨旋转是否能揭示功能上独立的子空间；以及线性级模块化，探讨有界线性映射能否将任务相关的计算分离到独立的子空间中。我们开发了一个统一的框架，用于在每个层次上学习分解，并通过选择性消融对分解进行因果评估。在视觉模型、语言模型和多任务循环神经网络（RNN）中，我们发现缺乏单元级模块化的网络往往在子空间层面表现出清晰的功能模块化。在视觉和语言模型中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个形式化的嵌套模块化层次结构（单元级、正交级和线性级），并通过统一的因果评估框架证明，即使神经网络在单个神经元层面缺乏模块化，它们在子空间层面往往仍表现出明显的功能模块化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a formally nested hierarchy of modularity (unit-level, orthogonal, and linear) and demonstrates through a unified causal evaluation framework that neural networks lacking unit-level modularity often exhibit clear functional modularity at the subspace level.
